content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":true,"reason":"Sells utility meters, meter-reading communication devices and utility data software to water and gas utilities, matching ESCO's utility metering business."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Makes microturbine power generation systems for onsite power users, a different business from ESCO's utility metering and grid products."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Is a plumbing, HVAC and waterworks distributor to contractors, not a manufacturer of metering, test or aerospace products."},{"label":"C4","good":true,"reason":"Designs smart electricity and gas meters, grid communication networks and utility software sold to utilities, closely matching ESCO's utility solutions."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Mainly makes industrial pumps, valves and friction products; its aerospace exposure is minor versus ESCO's metering and test businesses."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Makes coatings, sealants and roofing systems for construction and consumers, unrelated to ESCO's metering, filtration or defense products."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Designs and makes pumps for water, fire, petroleum and defense uses, not the metering, test or filtration businesses ESCO runs."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Its core is inkjet coding and marking printers for food and pharma makers; water instruments are a secondary line, not ESCO's utility metering."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Sells telecom network test and optical security products to carriers; its defense test overlap is small versus ESCO's power and utility testing."}]}
